verdict.rationale: Exa's pricing docs list a first-party capability for 'scheduled searches that surface new events on the web' (exa-docs-10). This is scoped to recurring web searches rather than arbitrary jobs or workflows. Websets can push real-time HTTP callbacks as items are added or enriched (exa-docs-21), which helps consume results from recurring runs. Missing for 10: documentation of schedule configuration (cadence, cron-style timing, API endpoints), scheduling of general workflows beyond searches (e.g., Agent or enrichment runs), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
